summary: Busy shopfront strip on Morrow Street, no kerb parking, dwellings within 10 m.
reasons: Main road with little kerb parking
Shops and apartments right behind kerb

best_section.where: Morrow Street south kerb outside Taringa Professional Centre

drivers.seclusion: Shops, offices and apartments back onto the kerb; Axis Taringa 10 m away, a house 4 m at the east end.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a through road; no marked parking lane and few parked cars visible.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with shopfronts and a church nearby.
drivers.convention: 2P signs Mon-Fri and Saturday; no overnight convention.

sun_shade: Street trees on the north side; buildings on the south, so mixed shade.
